system.description: Extra dice for one general skill (they carry over to its concentrations and specializations). Cost per die by area: Athletics .25, Stealth .25, Armed/Unarmed Combat, Throwing and Projectile Weapons .5, Firearms and Gunnery 1. A Combat Skill can't have more extra dice than its rating. SR2E p.125.
system.notes: SR2E p.125. Extra dice for a specific skill. Cost/die: Athletic/Stealth .25, Armed/Unarmed/Throwing/Projectile .5, Firearms/Gunnery 1. Combat skills: max extra dice ≤ current skill rating.
